question: Can even immense material wealth justify giving away this Kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined.
Someone may possess such an accumulation.
This immense wealth is posed as a comparison.
inference: Even the wealth to fill an ocean with jewels is not a sufficient price for this teaching.
uncertainties: The fused token ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is read as containing an infinitive sense without splitting.
plain_english: Even if one had the accumulation to make the ocean filled with jewels.
